source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
What structural components are inspected and why?
3. What is the purpose of a bridge inspection?

## 1. Start with maintenance records

When conducting a research study using _component based repair data_ to discover _predictive relationships between repair times and inspection records_, you may believe that such a relationship must exist. That is, a rational person may believe that the frequency of non-destructive and destructive testing will be predictive of repair times. Therefore, it is wise to leverage any maintenance records of structural testing before attempting to document new data.

Maintenance records can provide a historical record of 30 year's of repair data. Even if by chance no maintenance records of inspection records are available, records of inspection reports exist for inspection agencies to review for quality control.

# 2. Structural components inspected and why

What is the purpose of inspecting a component? If the source of an inspection is the contractor, any inspection performed is _qualified
